    <!-- Synchronous Theme Initialization (prevents flash/mismatch on page load) -->\n
    <script>\n
        (function() {\n
            const stored = localStorage.getItem('theme');\n
            let theme;\n
\n
            if (stored) {\n
                theme = stored;\n
            } else {\n
                theme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
                // Store the system preference so it's consistent across pages\n
                localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);\n
            }\n
\n
            if (theme === 'dark') {\n
                document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');\n
            } else {\n
                document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');\n
            }\n
        })();\n
    </script>\n

    <!-- Synchronous Theme Initialization (prevents flash/mismatch on page load) -->\n
    <script>\n
        (function() {\n
            const stored = localStorage.getItem('theme');\n
            let theme;\n
\n
            if (stored) {\n
                theme = stored;\n
            } else {\n
                theme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
                // Store the system preference so it's consistent across pages\n
                localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);\n
            }\n
\n
            if (theme === 'dark') {\n
                document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');\n
            } else {\n
                document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');\n
            }\n
        })();\n
    </script>\n

    <!-- Synchronous Theme Initialization (prevents flash/mismatch on page load) -->\n
    <script>\n
        (function() {\n
            const stored = localStorage.getItem('theme');\n
            let theme;\n
\n
            if (stored) {\n
                theme = stored;\n
            } else {\n
                theme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
                // Store the system preference so it's consistent across pages\n
                localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);\n
            }\n
\n
            if (theme === 'dark') {\n
                document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');\n
            } else {\n
                document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');\n
            }\n
        })();\n
    </script>\n

    <!-- Synchronous Theme Initialization (prevents flash/mismatch on page load) -->\n
    <script>\n
        (function() {\n
            const stored = localStorage.getItem('theme');\n
            let theme;\n
\n
            if (stored) {\n
                theme = stored;\n
            } else {\n
                theme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
                // Store the system preference so it's consistent across pages\n
                localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);\n
            }\n
\n
            if (theme === 'dark') {\n
                document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');\n
            } else {\n
                document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');\n
            }\n
        })();\n
    </script>\n

        window.accessibilitySettings.updateSettings({\r\n

            reducedMotion: this.reducedMotion,\r\n
            keyboardNav: this.keyboardNav\r\n

        this.textSize = 100;\r\n
        this.highContrast = false;\r\n
        this.reducedMotion = false;\r\n
        this.keyboardNav = false;\r\n
        this.applySettings();\r\n
        window.accessibilitySettings.announce('Accessibility settings reset to defaults', 'polite');\r\n
